newForms.name: Forgeback
newForms.lore: Its back-plates glow hotter after a good meal.

newForms.name: Emberplate
newForms.lore: Blacksmiths quietly follow it around for the free heat.

newForms.name: Cinderridge
newForms.lore: Walks slow so the whole caravan can warm up as it passes.

newForms.name: Calderaback
newForms.lore: Its back plates don't just glow anymore. They roar, quietly, all the time.

newForms.name: Voltneck
newForms.lore: Its neck alone conducts enough charge to light a village.

newForms.name: Stormspine
newForms.lore: Thunderheads gather wherever it grazes, out of habit more than threat.

newForms.name: Thunderwake
newForms.lore: The storm doesn't follow it. It just hasn't left yet.

newForms.name: Sandtrudge
newForms.lore: Never in a hurry. Never late, either.

newForms.name: Duneback
newForms.lore: Caravans trust it with the heaviest crates without asking twice.

newForms.name: Caravox
newForms.lore: Has crossed the Dunes so many times it could do it blind. Frequently does.

newForms.name: Wayfarox
newForms.lore: The dunes shift. Its route never does.

newForms.name: Voltstripe
newForms.lore: Its stripes crackle brighter every time it startles. It startles often.

newForms.name: Sparkrunner
newForms.lore: Outraces its own hoofbeats and gets there first.

newForms.name: Stormstrider
newForms.lore: Storm chasers just call it 'the forecast' now.

newForms.name: Thunderhoof
newForms.lore: Thunder used to follow lightning. Now it follows this.

newForms.name: Boneknight
newForms.lore: Still remembers its oath. Nobody remembers who it swore it to.

newForms.name: Cryptlord
newForms.lore: Its throne room has excellent acoustics and terrible visitor reviews.

newForms.name: Netherking
newForms.lore: Every rattling bone in the marsh salutes when it passes.

newForms.name: Hexwraith
newForms.lore: Its riddles have answers. It just prefers you keep guessing.

newForms.name: Curseweaver
newForms.lore: Ties a small curse into every hex like a ribbon on a gift.

newForms.name: Hexsovereign
newForms.lore: Speaks once a season. The marsh still hasn't finished unpacking the last riddle.

newForms.name: Windshroud
newForms.lore: You hear the cloak snap in the wind a half-second after it's already gone.

newForms.name: Gustblade
newForms.lore: Every draw of its blade sounds like a door closing somewhere else.

newForms.name: Wraithgale
newForms.lore: The marsh mist parts for it and doesn't quite close the same way after.

newForms.name: Fluttershriek
newForms.lore: Apologises to fewer trees now. Mostly by dodging them.

newForms.name: Nightwing
newForms.lore: Reads the shape of a room in sound before it enters it.

newForms.name: Dreadwing
newForms.lore: Its shriek arrives after it's already behind you.

newForms.name: Voidwing
newForms.lore: The dark doesn't hide it. It just stops arguing.

newForms.name: Coilfang
newForms.lore: Hisses a warning first. The warning is optional; the bite is not.

newForms.name: Vipercoil
newForms.lore: Coils patiently, sometimes for hours, always for effect.

newForms.name: Thornviper
newForms.lore: Nests in bramble specifically to match its own mood.

newForms.name: Venomcrown
newForms.lore: The Vale's other snakes flatten themselves when it passes.

prompts.name: Kilnback
prompts.prompt: A sturdy stegosaur-like creature with warm terracotta hide and a row of glowing orange back-plates, gentle eyes and slow deliberate steps, faint heat-shimmer rising off its spine.

prompts.name: Forgeback
prompts.prompt: A broader stegosaur with deeper rust-red hide and brighter, hotter-glowing back-plates, small curls of smoke rising between them as it walks.

prompts.name: Emberplate
prompts.prompt: A heftier stegosaur whose back-plates have thickened and darkened at the edges like cooling iron, glowing ember-orange cores visible through cracks, rust-red hide deepening toward brown.

prompts.name: Cinderridge
prompts.prompt: A massive stegosaur with a jagged ridge of dark, forge-hot plates running its full spine, deep umber-red hide seamed in glowing orange cracks, heat visibly rippling the air around it.

prompts.name: Calderaback
prompts.prompt: A titanic stegosaur whose back has become a living caldera ridge of dark volcanic plates glowing deep orange-gold at every seam, near-black hide radiating constant heat-haze, utterly monumental and warm-eyed despite its scale.

prompts.name: Thrumcrest

prompts.name: Thunderneck

prompts.name: Voltneck
prompts.prompt: An even taller sauropod whose crest now glows faintly gold, visible arcs of static travelling the full length of its long neck, hide deepening to a rich amber.

prompts.name: Stormspine
prompts.prompt: A colossal sauropod with a spine of small glowing storm-gold ridges running neck to tail, deep amber-bronze hide crackling with constant static, small clouds visibly gathering above its crest.

prompts.name: Thunderwake

prompts.name: Duneplod

prompts.name: Sandtrudge

prompts.name: Duneback

prompts.name: Wayfarox

prompts.name: Boltstripe
